key: CAL: Oh, \PN... You startled me.
en: CAL: Oh, \PN... You startled me.
ja: キャル: あ、\PN……びっくりしたよ。

key: But if you're here...
en: But if you're here...
ja: でも、君がここにいるってことは……

key: That's good. I couldn't ask for better backup.
en: That's good. I couldn't ask for better backup.
ja: よかった。これ以上心強い援軍はいないね。

key: As you heard, the mountain is slowly melting from the inside out.
en: As you heard, the mountain is slowly melting from the inside out.
ja: 聞いての通り、この山は内側からゆっくり溶けだしてるんだ。

key: Just now, I saw our culprit...
en: Just now, I saw our culprit...
ja: ちょうど今、犯人らしきものを見たんだけど……

key: A Heatran has spawned in here.
en: A Heatran has spawned in here.
ja: ヒードランが、この中に出現したみたいだ。

key: Just our luck.
en: Just our luck.
ja: ついてないよね。

key: This is only going to get worse as it goes on...
en: This is only going to get worse as it goes on...
ja: このままだと、どんどん悪化していく一方だよ……

key: Let's not waste time!
en: Let's not waste time!
ja: 時間を無駄にしないようにしよう!

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が結晶に反応した!

key: CAL: Despite the damage, some of the rocks around here are still frozen stuck...
en: CAL: Despite the damage, some of the rocks around here are still frozen stuck...
ja: キャル: これだけ損傷してても、このあたりの岩はまだ凍りついたままのところがあるんだ……

key: If it were any colder, this would be a no-go, but I've heated this one up enough that we should be able to smash through it.
en: If it were any colder, this would be a no-go, but I've heated this one up enough that we should be able to smash through it.
ja: これ以上冷たかったら無理だっただろうけど、こいつは十分に温めておいたから、砕けるはずだよ。

key: CAL: Thanks.
en: CAL: Thanks.
ja: キャル: ありがとう。

key: It's frozen solid in place...
en: It's frozen solid in place...
ja: ここは完全に凍りついている……

key: CAL: Heatran moved up through that exit...
en: CAL: Heatran moved up through that exit...
ja: キャル: ヒードランは、あの出口から上に移動したみたいだ……

key: CAL: But with that lava in the way...
en: CAL: But with that lava in the way...
ja: キャル: でも、あの溶岩が邪魔で……

key: CAL: And that boiling water...
en: CAL: And that boiling water...
ja: キャル: それに、あの煮えたぎるお湯も……

key: I don't think any Pokémon could safely surf across it.
en: I don't think any Pokémon could safely surf across it.
ja: どんなポケモンでも、あそこを安全に泳ぎ切るのは無理だと思う。

key: CAL: Ugh... What can we do?
en: CAL: Ugh... What can we do?
ja: キャル: うぅ……どうすればいいんだろう?

key: My Fire Types aren't helpful at all here when the place is already melting down.
en: My Fire Types aren't helpful at all here when the place is already melting down.
ja: こんなに溶けかけてるところじゃ、僕の炎タイプは全然役に立たないよ。

key: ???: Shoulda came prepared, oaf-for-brains.
en: ???: Shoulda came prepared, oaf-for-brains.
ja: ???: 準備してこなかったのかよ、脳みそ筋肉野郎。

key: CAL: ...
en: CAL: ...
ja: キャル: ……

key: BLAKE: Sup?
en: BLAKE: Sup?
ja: ブレイク: よぉ。

key: CAL: Blake, let's not do this right now.
en: CAL: Blake, let's not do this right now.
ja: キャル: ブレイク、今それはやめてくれよ。

key: We're kind of in the middle of something.
en: We're kind of in the middle of something.
ja: こっちはちょっと大変な最中なんだから。

key: BLAKE: No shit.
en: BLAKE: No shit.
ja: ブレイク: だろうな。

key: And here I thought you two were just having a hot spring date.
en: And here I thought you two were just having a hot spring date.
ja: てっきり二人で温泉デートでもしてるのかと思ったぜ。

key: Chillax, bro.
en: Chillax, bro.
ja: 落ち着けって、兄弟。

key: I'm here to help.
en: I'm here to help.
ja: 手伝いに来たんだよ。

key: You just sit back and let your ol' big brother take care of this.
en: You just sit back and let your ol' big brother take care of this.
ja: お前は座って、頼れる兄貴に任せておけばいいさ。

key: CAL: And what do you gain from this?
en: CAL: And what do you gain from this?
ja: キャル: それで、君に何の得があるんだい?

key: BLAKE: ...
en: BLAKE: ...
ja: ブレイク: ……

key: So, look.
en: So, look.
ja: あのな。

key: I know I may have been involved in a plot to, you know, starve our entire city or whatever.
en: I know I may have been involved in a plot to, you know, starve our entire city or whatever.
ja: 街全体を飢えさせるとか、そういう企みに一枚かんでたのは、まあ分かってるよ。

key: Believe me, I know saying that that wasn't very cool of me would be the understatement of the century.
en: Believe me, I know saying that that wasn't very cool of me would be the understatement of the century.
ja: 「あれはあんまりカッコよくなかった」なんて言葉じゃ、控えめすぎるってのも分かってる。

key: And I'm not gonna suddenly claim that I've grown an entire heart and found altruistic nirvana like you have,
en: And I'm not gonna suddenly claim that I've grown an entire heart and found altruistic nirvana like you have,
ja: お前みたいに急に心を入れ替えて、利他の境地にでも達しましたなんて言うつもりもない。

key: But if the mountain goes down, so does the city we were raised in.
en: But if the mountain goes down, so does the city we were raised in.
ja: でも、この山が崩れたら、俺たちが育ったあの街もろとも終わりだ。

key: I may have been under the eco-terrorist group, but even they just wanted the people out-- not the whole damn thing to collapse.
en: I may have been under the eco-terrorist group, but even they just wanted the people out-- not the whole damn thing to collapse.
ja: あのエコテロリスト集団の下にいたのは事実だけど、連中だって住民を追い出したかっただけで、街を丸ごと崩壊させたかったわけじゃない。

key: I still call that place home, even though I don't sleep a wink without thinking how I don't deserve to anymore.
en: I still call that place home, even though I don't sleep a wink without thinking how I don't deserve to anymore.
ja: それでも俺は、あそこを今でも「地元」って呼んでる。もうそう呼ぶ資格なんてないって、毎晩考えずにはいられないけどな。

key: So can we spare me having to deliver an entire guilt- laden monologue?
en: So can we spare me having to deliver an entire guilt- laden monologue?
ja: だから、罪悪感たっぷりの長ったらしい独白は勘弁してくれないか?

key: BLAKE: ...Or at least put it off until AFTER we stop the entire place from coming down?
en: BLAKE: ...Or at least put it off until AFTER we stop the entire place from coming down?
ja: ブレイク: ……せめて、ここが完全に崩れ落ちるのを止めた後まで、取っといてくれないか?

key: You need Ice Types; I've got them.
en: You need Ice Types; I've got them.
ja: こおりタイプが必要なんだろ、俺が持ってる。

key: Let's stop butting heads for two seconds and solve the goddamn problem.
en: Let's stop butting heads for two seconds and solve the goddamn problem.
ja: ちょっとの間だけ、いがみ合うのはやめて、このクソ問題を片付けようぜ。

key: All right?
en: All right?
ja: いいな?

key: CAL: Fine.
en: CAL: Fine.
ja: キャル: 分かったよ。

key: \PN, you're running the show.
en: \PN, you're running the show.
ja: \PN、指揮は君に任せるよ。

key: We'll wait in the center for your word, and one of us can either heat up or cool down the room as necessary to help you move through it.
en: We'll wait in the center for your word, and one of us can either heat up or cool down the room as necessary to help you move through it.
ja: 僕たちは中央で待機して、必要に応じて部屋を熱くしたり冷やしたりするから、君が進めるように合図してくれ。

key: You just let us know.
en: You just let us know.
ja: 合図さえくれれば大丈夫だから。

key: BLAKE: I'll get us started on that sweet, sweet cooperation...
en: BLAKE: I'll get us started on that sweet, sweet cooperation...
ja: ブレイク: この最高に甘美な協力ってやつを、始めてやるよ……

key: That's the whole hero shebang, right?
en: That's the whole hero shebang, right?
ja: それがヒーローってやつの決まりだろ?

key: CAL: Don't get comfortable. I still don't trust you.
en: CAL: Don't get comfortable. I still don't trust you.
ja: キャル: 調子に乗るなよ。まだ君のことは信用してない。

key: BLAKE: So then... you might say that I'm on thin ice?
en: BLAKE: So then... you might say that I'm on thin ice?
ja: ブレイク: つまり……俺は薄氷を踏んでるってわけか?

key: BLAKE: Ow.
en: BLAKE: Ow.
ja: ブレイク: いてっ。

key: All right, all right; I deserved that...
en: All right, all right; I deserved that...
ja: はいはい、そりゃ自業自得だな……

key: CAL: Do you want me to take over?
en: CAL: Do you want me to take over?
ja: キャル: 僕が代わろうか?

key: CAL: Right. Then stand back; we're turning up the heat.
en: CAL: Right. Then stand back; we're turning up the heat.
ja: キャル: よし。じゃあ下がってて、温度を上げるよ。

key: Just let me know.
en: Just let me know.
ja: 合図をくれればいいから。

key: CAL: While the room's heated, ice will melt, and some rocks will become warm and susceptible to breaking.
en: CAL: While the room's heated, ice will melt, and some rocks will become warm and susceptible to breaking.
ja: キャル: 部屋が温まってる間は、氷が溶けて、岩の一部も熱で砕けやすくなるはずだよ。

key: Certain crystals that have been tainted by Heatran's power might also allow you to break nearby ice.
en: Certain crystals that have been tainted by Heatran's power might also allow you to break nearby ice.
ja: ヒードランの力に染まった結晶なら、近くの氷を砕けるようになるかもしれない。

key: However, some of the water might become too warm for any Pokémon to cross.
en: However, some of the water might become too warm for any Pokémon to cross.
ja: ただ、水の一部はどのポケモンでも渡れないくらい熱くなるかもしれない。

key: Maybe a Volcanion could, but anything else...
en: Maybe a Volcanion could, but anything else...
ja: ボルケニオンなら渡れるかもしれないけど、他は……

key: BLAKE: Volcanion can't surf, bro.
en: BLAKE: Volcanion can't surf, bro.
ja: ブレイク: ボルケニオンって、なみのりできねえんだよ、兄弟。

key: CAL: What do you mean Volcanion can't surf?
en: CAL: What do you mean Volcanion can't surf?
ja: キャル: なみのりできないって、どういうことだい?

key: It's a Water Type Legendary...
en: It's a Water Type Legendary...
ja: 水タイプの伝説のポケモンなのに……

key: BLAKE: Doesn't work. Look it up.
en: BLAKE: Doesn't work. Look it up.
ja: ブレイク: 無理なんだって。調べてみろよ。

key: ...Even a Volcanion, apparently.
en: ...Even a Volcanion, apparently.
ja: ……ボルケニオンでも、そうらしい。

key: Why...? Is it too heavy?
en: Why...? Is it too heavy?
ja: なんで……? 重すぎるとか?

key: BLAKE: No way, bro.
en: BLAKE: No way, bro.
ja: ブレイク: いや、それはねえよ、兄弟。

key: Aggron's way heavier, and Aggron can swim.
en: Aggron's way heavier, and Aggron can swim.
ja: ボスゴドラの方がずっと重いのに、あいつは泳げるんだぜ。

key: CAL: ...Aggron can swim?
en: CAL: ...Aggron can swim?
ja: キャル: ……ボスゴドラって泳げるの?

key: BLAKE: Yeah, bro. Check its butterfly stroke.
en: BLAKE: Yeah, bro. Check its butterfly stroke.
ja: ブレイク: ああ、兄弟。あいつのバタフライ、見てみろよ。

key: CAL: No, it's-- How does it...
en: CAL: No, it's-- How does it...
ja: キャル: いや、それは――どうやって……

key: Forget it. I give up.
en: Forget it. I give up.
ja: もういいや。降参だよ。

key: BLAKE: My turn?
en: BLAKE: My turn?
ja: ブレイク: 俺の番か?

key: BLAKE: Walrein, let's put 'em on ice!
en: BLAKE: Walrein, let's put 'em on ice!
ja: ブレイク: トドゼルガ、こいつらを凍らせてやろうぜ!

key: BLAKE: That's cool.
en: BLAKE: That's cool.
ja: ブレイク: そりゃクールだ。

key: Just try to not burn the entire place down.
en: Just try to not burn the entire place down.
ja: ここを丸ごと燃やしたりしないようにな。

key: BLAKE: Walrein and I got this; it's chill.
en: BLAKE: Walrein and I got this; it's chill.
ja: ブレイク: トドゼルガと俺に任せとけ、楽勝だ。

key: While it's cooling down the room, some water will freeze over into ice.
en: While it's cooling down the room, some water will freeze over into ice.
ja: 部屋が冷えてる間、水の一部が凍って氷になるはずだ。

key: The boiling water won't freeze, and will become cool enough to swim in.
en: The boiling water won't freeze, and will become cool enough to swim in.
ja: 煮えたぎってた水は凍らずに、泳げるくらいまで冷めるだろう。

key: Additionally, some of these crystals may be able to be popped to open up pathways across the lava.
en: Additionally, some of these crystals may be able to be popped to open up pathways across the lava.
ja: それに、この結晶の一部を割れば、溶岩を渡る通り道が開けるかもな。

key: Or that's my guess, anywho.
en: Or that's my guess, anywho.
ja: まあ、あくまで俺の予想だけどな。

key: Sic' it to 'em, champ,
en: Sic' it to 'em, champ,
ja: ぶちかましてやれよ、チャンプ、

key: Or whatever cliché supportive crap we're tossing around today.
en: Or whatever cliché supportive crap we're tossing around today.
ja: って、今日はそういうお決まりの応援台詞でも投げとくか。

key: Skip Ametrine Core puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Ametrine Core puzzle on this file?
ja: アメトリン中枢のパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
